title: Business Development Associate - Public Sector
description: Who we are: Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities. Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes. Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram . Who you are: We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Business Development Associate who will grow new and expansion revenue by helping small and medium-sized fleets find the right fleet management solutions. In this early-career sales role, you will build customer relationships, develop your sales expertise, and make a measurable contribution to Geotab's growth. If you love connecting with customers and helping businesses solve real-world fleet challenges, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you! What you'll do: As a Business Development Associate, your key area of responsibility will be developing new and expansion sales opportunities with small and medium-sized business customers, generally fleets with 5 to 50 vehicles. You will manage assigned leads and opportunities, work toward an individual annual recurring revenue growth target, identify customer needs, and present relevant Geotab solutions. You will use established sales processes to qualify prospects, build pipeline through direct outreach and partner and referral programs, conduct discovery conversations and demonstrations, and move standard opportunities forward. You will keep customer activity and opportunity information up to date in Salesloft and Salesforce, and seek guidance when requirements or deals are more complex. You will work closely with Business Development leaders, Revenue Operations, Partner Account Managers, Marketing, and other cross-functional colleagues to help customers and partners progress opportunities and to follow consistent sales practices. You will build your knowledge of telematics, fleet management, Geotab products, competitors, and SMB fleet challenges, while using customer and market research and developing AI capabilities to work more effectively. To thrive in this role, you will be curious, resilient, organized, collaborative, motivated by measurable goals, and open to coaching and continuous improvement. How you'll make an impact: Manage an assigned list of SMB accounts and sales opportunities, typically serving fleets with 5 to 50 vehicles but may differ by segment. Use established partner and referral programs, including emerging SMB initiatives, to generate qualified pipeline and advance standard SMB opportunities through the sales process at high velocities. Deliver clear presentations, product overviews, and demonstrations appropriate to the customer's needs. Build working knowledge of telematics, fleet management, Geotab products, and common SMB fleet challenges. Prospect for and qualify new logo opportunities and identify expansion opportunities within existing SMB accounts. Execute account and opportunity plans for assigned SMB prospects using approved phone, email, digital, partner, referral, and other established selling motions. Use established discovery questions to understand customer needs, fleet challenges, and buying processes, and connect standard requirements to relevant Geotab solutions. Maintain accurate opportunity stages, next steps, activities, and close dates in Salesloft and SFDC; seek guidance on complex or non-standard requirements. Collaborate with Business Development leadership, Revenue Operations, Partner Account Managers, Marketing, and other cross-functional stakeholders to progress opportunities and follow established sales practices. Engage all inbound leads assigned for your territory and manage conversion & reseller referral process Develop awareness of competitors, market trends, and segment-specific sales narratives. Seek coaching, apply feedback, and continuously improve prospecting, discovery, negotiation, and closing skills. Share relevant customer and market observations with the team to inform established planning, competitive analysis, and revenue-forecasting processes. Work collaboratively with partners and cross-functional teams, and use developing AI capabilities to improve research, prospecting, preparation, and selling efficiency. Use customer and market research to identify opportunities and understand SMB fleet pain points. Build the product, industry, and competitive expertise needed to progress into a Business Development Representative role. What you'll bring to the role: A post-secondary diploma or degree; an equivalent combination of education and/or work experience in related fields may be substituted. A bachelor's degree or diploma in Business, Commerce, Marketing, Communications, or a related field is preferred. 1–3 years of previous experience in sales, business development, customer development, account management, customer service, or a related field; experience with prospecting, relationship building, CRM systems, and partner or referral programs i Strong communication, listening, research, and relationship-building skills. Ability to learn technical and business concepts quickly and translate customer needs into relevant solutions. Comfort with prospecting, outreach, discovery conversations, presentations, and follow-up. Strong organization, time management, and attention to detail when managing multiple opportunities. A coachable, resilient, curious approach and motivation to achieve measurable goals. Ability to work collaboratively with partners and cross-functional teams. Familiarity with Salesloft, SFDC, CRM systems, or sales engagement tools is an asset. Comfort using developing AI capabilities to improve research, prospecting, preparation, and selling efficiency. Ability to use market and customer research to identify opportunities and understand SMB fleet pain points. If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees. This posting is for an existing vacancy. Why job seekers choose Geotab: Flex working arrangements Home office reimbursement program Baby bonus & parental leave top up program Online learning and networking opportunities Electric vehicle purchase incentive program Competitive medical and dental benefits Retirement savings program *The above are offered to full-time permanent employees only How we work: At Geotab, we have adopted a flexible hybrid working model in that we have systems, functions, programs and policies in place to support both in-person and virtual work. However, you are welcomed and encouraged to come into our beautiful, safe, clean offices as often as you like. When working from home, you are required to have a reliable internet connection with at least 50mb DL/10mb UL. Virtual work is supported with cloud-based applications, collaboration tools and asynchronous working. The health and safety of employees are a top priority. We encourage work-life balance and keep the Geotab culture going strong with online social events, chat rooms and gatherings. Join us and help reshape the future of technology! We believe that ensuring diversity is fundamental to our future growth and progress and is an integral part of our business. We believe that success happens where new ideas can flourish – in an environment that is rich in diversity and a place where people from various backgrounds can work together. Geotab encourages applications from all qualified individuals. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities during the recruitment and assessment processes and when people are hired. We will ensure the accessibility needs of employees with disabilities are taken into account as part of performance management, career development, training and redeployment processes. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information about our diversity and inclusion as well as accommodation policies and practices, please contact us at careers@geotab.com. By submitting a job application to Geotab Inc. or its affiliates and subsidiaries (collectively, “Geotab”), you acknowledge Geotab’s collection, use and disclosure of your personal data in accordance with our Privacy Policy . Click here to read our Privacy Notice. The On-Target Earnings (OTE) range for this position represents the total expected annual compensation, consisting of a base salary and commission/incentives. This may be subject to change. Geotab offers various perks and benefits and other compensation components that an individual may be eligible for. The actual salary for this position depends on a variety of factors such as but not limited to skills, qualifications, education and overall experience, including the location the applicant lives while performing the job. This also includes equity with other team members and alignment with local market data. All offers of employment are contingent upon proof of eligibility to work and the individual's ability to pass a background check. On-Target Earnings (OTE) Range $110,000 — $160,000 USD

title: Intern, Client Experience Strategy & Operations
description: BUILD SOMETHING PEOPLE LOVE Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $155 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada. We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture and learn more about how we work https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers. INTERN, CLIENT EXPERIENCE STRATEGY & OPERATIONS (WINTER 2027) Location: Toronto, ON (Hybrid) Term: 8 months, beginning January 11, 2027. This is an 8 month internship designed for co-op students, non-co-op students, and recent graduates who are ready to ship impactful work. During your internship, you will have the opportunity to contribute to projects that are changing the landscape of financial services for Canadians. You will be on a team that supports your growth, provides mentorship, and connects you to the broader Wealthsimple community! Our internship program operates on a hybrid model, where you’ll be working from our Toronto headquarters on Wednesdays and Thursdays. This structure offers the flexibility of remote work, while also providing the collaboration, connection, and mentorship that come from being together in person. This posting covers two tracks: Workflow Optimization and Enablement. Please apply to the one that best fits your interests. Please note: the role you apply for is the role you will be assessed on throughout the interview process. We are unable to accommodate requests to switch between Workflow Optimization and Enablement tracks after submission. ABOUT THE CX OPERATIONS TEAM The CX Operations team is responsible for enabling exceptional client and agent experiences across Wealthsimple through optimized systems, content, AI solutions, and strategic initiatives. We manage the technology, knowledge, and processes that power our customer experience organization, driving continuous improvement in efficiency and effectiveness. CHOOSE YOUR TRACK: WORKFLOW OPTIMIZATION, INTERN Workflow Optimization (WFO) streamlines the workflows, systems, and automations that span our entire ecosystem of tools. We partner with teams across the organization to identify and simplify toilsome workflows through process mapping, automation, and AI tool implementations. As a WFO Intern, you'll partner with WFO managers and internal SMEs to: design and build AI tools for analysis; audit and improve automations; map and redesign workflows; and deliver measurable improvements in containment, resolution time, and operational risk. You'll develop core skills in project planning, process design, AI tool deployment, and AI‑enhanced automation while contributing directly to CX efficiency and client experience. IN THIS ROLE, YOU’LL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO - Partner with the AI Experiences team to launch net-new features to our clients and support agents. - Map current-state workflows with SMEs, identify optimization opportunities, and implement AI-enhanced changes across macros, automations, and documentation. - Build comprehensive automation inventories across multiple systems, to propose consolidations and net-new automations and AI optimizations. WHAT YOU’LL BRING - Structured problem solving and process thinking, with the ability to translate ambiguous workflows into clear maps and requirements - Basic familiarity with AI concepts (LLM, RAG, context windows, hallucination, etc.) - Basic familiarity with customer operations tools or ticketing systems (Zendesk, JIRA) - Basic familiarity with data and testing concepts – to be applied in the context of testing the accuracy of AI models (A/B testing, sample sizes, statistical significance, etc.) - Strong documentation and communication skills to collaborate with SMEs and present proposals - Bias to action and ownership to drive projects from discovery to implementation ENABLEMENT, INTERN Our enablement group is responsible for how our support workforce learns, performs, and grows. We build the systems, programs, and culture that keep our support teams performing at a high bar. Quality, learning, change readiness, and performance measurement all sit within this group. Underneath all of it is a simple belief: every client interaction should be fast, high-quality, and trustworthy. Our job is to turn that belief into measurable reality. As an Enablement Intern, you'll support the group's analytical work. You'll partner with the managers who own quality and performance measurement to test the data, run original analyses, spot trends early, and turn your findings into recommendations leaders can act on. This goes beyond reporting, the question is never only "what does the number say?" It's also "is this measuring the right thing, and what should we do about it?" You'll build skills in analysis, metric design, and structured problem solving, and see up close how an AI-first quality and performance program runs in a regulated industry. The best person for this role doesn't only meet a high bar; they hold their own work to one. IN THIS ROLE, YOU’LL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO - Design and run trending analyses across scorecard metrics to inform target reviews, and build a repeatable way of doing them so each review doesn't start from scratch - Look for relationships between metrics, such as how quality, satisfaction and efficiency move together, and turn what you find into clear charts and recommendations - Help define and document metrics: what each one measures, where its data comes from, and where two metrics overlap or one is only raw input to another - Build checks and first-pass reviews that help the team catch errors in scorecards and reports before they’re finalized - Support analysis of quality data, such as sampling and summarizing results, as projects call for it WHAT YOU’LL BRING - Strong quantitative and spreadsheet skills, and comfort cleaning, joining and pivoting messy data (SQL is a plus) - An understanding of how relational data fits together (tables, keys, joins). SQL is a plus but not required - Experience building trend analyses and visualizations, and the judgment to tell a real pattern from noise - Basic familiarity with statistical concepts like correlation, sample sizes and significance - Basic familiarity with ticketing tools and support systems, and where support data comes from - Structured problem solving: you can turn a vague question into a hypothesis, an analysis and a clear "so what" - Clear writing, including explaining a finding to the person who has to act on it - Ownership and a bias to action, taking work from question to recommendation ELIGIBILITY ✔ Currently enrolled as a student at a Canadian post-secondary institution or technical bootcamp ✔ New graduates - Within 6 months of your graduation date ✔ Available to work full-time hours ✔ Residing in Canada ✔ Able to commute to our Toronto HQ on Wednesdays and Thursdays COMPENSATION & EQUITY 🤑 Base salary range: For this role, candidates can expect the following base salary range: • Term 1 students: CAD $42,000 - $44,000 • Term 2 students: CAD $44,000 - $46,000 • Term 3 students: CAD $46,000 - $48,000 • Term 4 students: CAD $48,000 - $50,000 • Term 5 students: CAD $49,000 - $52,000 Your current year of study and number of past internship terms will determine your salary band. Actual compensation within each band is based on skills, experience, and academic performance. Exceptional candidates may be considered above the top of their year's range. 🚀 WHY WEALTHSIMPLE? 🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance 📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business 🌴 20 vacation days, 4 wellness days, and unlimited sick and mental health days per year* ✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year* 👥 Employee resource groups, including Rainbow (2SLGBTQ), Women of WS, and Black at WS 🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. The people are one of the best parts of working here: you'll collaborate with incredibly talented, curious, and driven teammates who are deeply committed to doing great work. *Unlimited paid sick days, Wellness Days and the 90 day away program do not apply to certain roles. ICYMI Technology & Innovation at Wealthsimple: We move quickly and build thoughtfully. That means we're always looking for better ways to work — whether that's new tools, AI, or rethinking how we approach a problem. We don't expect you to have all the answers, but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to evolve alongside the products we're building. Inclusion Statement: We're building products for a diverse world, and we need a diverse team to do it well. We strongly encourage applications from everyone, regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status. Accessibility Statement: We're committed to an accessible hiring experience. If you need any accommodations throughout the interview process, please let us know — we'll work with you to make sure you have what you need. We also welcome any feedback on how we can better accommodate candidates with accessibility needs. AI in Hiring: We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our team but don't replace human judgment – all final hiring decisions are made by people. If you have questions about how your data is used, reach out to us.
